extras: Requires Obsidian v1.11.4 or later. Custom icons may not work with Quartz.
intentEvidence: This plugin for Obsidian adds a new bases view: 'Leaflet Map' and a new type of property: 'marker'
motivation: To leverage the versatility of Obsidian bases, ensure marker data belongs to the note rather than the map, and enable map availability in an online garden using Quartz.
problem: Users need a way to visualize geographical or fantasy locations within Obsidian bases and associate specific data points (markers) with those locations.

relations.evidence: The OG for Obsidian fantasy maps has to be mentioned. It is no longer under active development and has been in maintenance mode for years.
If you do not wish to use Obsidian bases, your markers to be saved in your notes, nor to host your garden using Quartz then I highly recommend you to take a look at this plugin!
My inspiration and my frustration, for it does not allow images to be used for your maps, and the workarounds are difficult, not accessible, and tend to break GitHub ToS.

summary: Leaflet Bases adds an interactive Leaflet Map view to Obsidian bases and introduces a 'marker' property for placing location data on the map.
